text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'm Oguri Cap.
...Pleased to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I have many people back home supporting me.
I want to... live up to their expectations.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"For that reason, I must eat plenty and work hard.
...Mm. Talking about it has made me hungry."

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
